title: LLM and agent evaluations
description: Checks for repeatable evaluations of model output, agent decisions and permitted tool use.

sources.title: Anthropic, Demystifying evals for AI agents

rules.instruction: Choose representative and boundary tasks from the intended use. Write a rubric for the result, uncertainty and user-visible errors, and review it with the person who owns the workflow.
rules.verification: Check that the cases cover critical paths and that graders agree on a sample of passing and failing outputs.

rules.instruction: Use recorded or simulated tool results to test whether the agent selects permitted tools, passes valid arguments and stops for required approvals.
rules.verification: Inspect the tool traces from evaluation runs. Verify that no live external action occurred in the test and that blocked steps stop as expected.

rules.instruction: Record the model, prompts, tool interfaces, test data and scoring version. Use repeated trials where output varies and report the performance of each critical task group.
rules.verification: Run the evaluation against the approved baseline and the proposed configuration. Review changed cases and record the release decision.
